title: 누구의 거예요? 친구의 책, 제 이름
objective: By the end, you can say who owns something with N의 N, and use 제 and 내 correctly. You will also know when 의 is often dropped in speech and how it is usually pronounced.
summary: Learn how to say whose something is with the particle 의, including the short forms 제 and 내 and how 의 is pronounced.

task.title: Use 의, 제, and 내
task.line: For each item, choose, write, or check the correct form, following the instruction.

forms.when: Owner first, then the thing owned. 의 goes after the owner. It is the same after a vowel or a consonant.
Polite speech, talking about yourself. 제 is the short form of 저의 and is much more common.
Casual speech with close friends or younger people. 내 is the short form of 나의.
In everyday speech, 의 is often left out between two nouns. With 우리 (our/my), it is almost always dropped: 우리 엄마, 우리 집.
forms.exampleMeaning: Where is my younger sibling's bag?

forms.when: When 의 means "'s", people usually say [에], but you still write 의.

watchOut: 제의 이름 (X) → 제 이름 (O): 제 already includes 의, so don't add 의 again.
나 이름 (X) → 내 이름 (O): 나 alone can't mean "my". Use 내 (or 나의).
책의 친구 (X) → 친구의 책 (O): the owner comes first, then the thing.
친구에 책 (X) → 친구의 책 (O): you say [에], but always write 의.
exercises: Choose the right form: ① (제 / 제의) 전화번호예요. ② 이거 (나 / 내) 책상이야. ③ (아버지의 / 아버지에) 시계예요.
Write in Korean with 의: ① Jiyeon's shoes (지연 = Jiyeon, 신발 = shoes) ② the doctor's phone number (의사 = doctor, 전화번호 = phone number)
Rewrite the sentence using the one-word short form of 저의: 저의 생일은 5월이에요.
How is 의 usually pronounced here? Write the phrase in Hangul as it sounds: 엄마의 이름
Write O if the sentence is correct and X if it is wrong: ① 제의 가방이 커요. ② 이건 우리 집이에요. ③ 나 컵이 어디 있어? ④ 오빠의 차가 커요.
answers: ① 제 ② 내 ③ 아버지의
① 지연의 신발 ② 의사의 전화번호
① X (제 가방이 커요.) ② O ③ X (내 컵이 어디 있어?) ④ O
